title: BLACKPINK’s History-Making Accomplishments: A Timeline
summary: "All the records are the results of our fans, BLINKs, and their unconditional support," Jennie has said of the group's success.
contentText:
Since debuting on Aug. 8, 2016, BLACKPINK has been busy not only making music, but repeatedly collecting accolades. Besides climbing the charts with the group’s well-received releases and catchy tunes, the quartet of LISA, JENNIE, ROSÉ and JISOO has been raking in numerous firsts as an all-female K-pop group beloved all over the world.

“It’s very surprising to us. All the records are the results of our fans, BLINKs, and their unconditional support,” Jennie told Grammy.com of the group’s success in September 2020. “Every day we try to acknowledge how grateful we are, but more than the pressure, we are ready to give them back as much as they gave us. It just gives us more motivation to go further than we ever dreamed of.”

And BLACKPINK is primed to knock down even more records after they regrouped in 2025 to embark on the DEADLINE World Tour, followed by the release of album DEADLINE in 2026, all after taking some time apart to pursue solo projects.

As the global K-pop superstar group marks a decade since its 2016 debut with single album Square One — which features “Whistle” and “Boombayah” — see what BLACKPINK has managed to accomplish together thus far as a quartet.
